verdict.rationale: Belvo ships automation-like features, such as Smart Collections that watch balances and recurrent links that refresh weekly, so asking about versioning them is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence documents versioning, review, change history, or rollback of those automations. Webhooks, Postman collections and MCP connectors are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
